title: One-step input-head movement bound
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $p$ be an input-head position among the $n+2$ positions, and let $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$ be a movement sign. After the clamped movement by $m$, the new position is at most $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is one of the $n+2$ input-head positions
